newsitem.title: USA: Starbucks to raise coffee prices Friday.
newsitem.headline: Starbucks to raise coffee prices Friday.

text.p: Starbucks Corp said it will on Friday raise coffee prices for the second time this year in a reflection of skyrocketing prices for the commodity on world markets.
The Seattle-based chain said in a statement it will raise prices for drip coffee by five cents a cup and for espresso by 10 cents a cup at its approximately 1,100 stores.
Starbucks also said it will raise the price of whole bean coffee by 40 cents a lb.

"Tighter supplies and increased demand for coffee have been causing prices to continue to rise worldwide," Starbucks said in its statement, noting that green coffee prices recently hit a 20-year high.
"Even though we are taking a price increase, we are only taking the minimal increase to ffset these higher costs," the company stated.
